question: Who is designated as the animal within the Kula when placed amid the yoginī group?
premises: A being is situated in the middle of the yoginī group.
That being is called an animal.
This designation is made in the Kula tradition.
inference: In the Kula, the one placed in the midst of the yoginī group is called the animal.
plain_english: In the Kula, he who is situated in the middle of the yoginī group is called the animal.
